title: Team Lead – Survey Programming (Qualtrics)
locationText: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India; Pune, Maharashtra, India
description:
Overview:  

Guidepoint's Market Research Team is seeking a leader for its Survey Programming team, to help centralize, standardize, and grow a function dedicated to programming and coding questionnaires into web-based platforms, and conducting QA on programmed survey work. This position would be expected to work hours aligned with US-based colleagues on the East Coast.

This can be a hybrid position out of one of our offices in India (Mumbai, Pune,) or remote.

What You’ll Do:  

• Oversee a team of 6 survey programmers of differing experience levels, setting standards for quality assurance and timely delivery of questionnaires programmed into Qualtrics

• Coordinate with other quantitative survey operational team leads (fieldwork, data automation) and client service staff/project managers to ensure effective cross-functional collaboration

• Serve as a strategic lead for survey programming within the market research organization, helping to design processes, systems, and best practice documentation for survey programming at Guidepoint

• Train and mentor junior staff on best practices for survey programming and coding, including improving efficiency in translating spec documents to final survey designs, effectively testing routing and randomization for accuracy, and using JavaScript and other custom web design languages to create custom layouts and presentations to meet client needs

• Serve as a senior voice for internal communication, stepping in to resolve project issues between team members and operational staff, provide leadership on kickoffs for complex or sustained engagements, and serve as an advisor on sales or internal kick-off calls where demonstrated programming experience is needed

• Consult as needed with survey project teams on survey design, making best-practice recommendations on question type or structure that will best work within our systems and reduce respondent burden, and flagging any designs that may be particularly time-consuming or challenging to execute successfully

• Serve as a direct project manager on large or urgent work as-needed

• Other duties as required

What You Have:  

• 10+ years experience in programming market research surveys in Qualtrics (strongly preferred) or another online survey platform (Decipher/Forsta, Alchemer, Sawtooth, Versive)

• 3+ years experience managing teams of programmers or other operations staff in market research to achieve targets on volume, timeliness, and quality

• Ability to interface with internal leaders, helping to set strategy and training goals for survey programming, identify and resolve problems at a project and strategic level as they arise

• Experience with JavaScript/jQuery, HTML, and CSS for developing custom question types or presentations, including training and upskilling staff on web design languages and tools

• Experience QAing surveys and designing survey QA processes and workflows to ensure that work aligns to requested spec/design work

• Ability to consult and train on best practices for survey design and experience, flagging if survey designs may have issues that make them difficult for end-respondents to answer

What we Offer:

• Competitive compensation

• Employee medical coverage

• Central office location

• Entrepreneurial environment, autonomy, and fast decisions

• Casual work environment  

About Guidepoint:

Guidepoint powers end-to-end research workflows for the world’s best research teams.  

 Backed by a global network of more than 2 million experts and over 1,600 employees, Guidepoint delivers real-time access to expertise, primary research, and actionable knowledge that help organizations make informed decisions. Through consultations, surveys, events, proprietary content, and AI-enabled tools, we support every stage of the decision-making process-from developing hypotheses and gathering insights to validating assumptions and building conviction for critical decisions.

title: Sleep Consultant (Part-Time)
description:
Join the Rest Revolution

The world is wired and tired. It's plagued by screens, notifications, and the sense that you should always be doing ... something. But hey, you're reading this job application right now, so you probably know exactly what we're talking about.

So here's a bit of good news amidst all the noise: Hatch is a sleep wellness company that's betting on rest in a culture obsessed with optimization. While most technology is designed to keep you engaged, our devices use the science of habit formation to help people unplug, unwind, and recharge. Through genuinely enjoyable routines, habit building, and gentle guidance (no sleep scores or wearables here), we help people build healthier sleep habits and feel the difference in everyday life.

More than a decade ago, we started with a mission to help parents navigate the complexities of newborn sleep. Today, we're helping more than 5 million people (and counting) take care of themselves and the people they love through the power of rest.

We’re open to candidates across the U.S. and Canada. However, please note that Hatch is based in California, so we just ask that you're available during PST/PDT hours.

The Opportunity
As a Sleep Consultant, you are the voice of Hatch ’s sleep support. You will connect with caregivers through sleep chat in the Hatch Baby app, offering warm, personalized guidance that helps them understand their child’s sleep, choose realistic next steps, and feel supported along the way. You balance developmental accuracy with genuine care, and you are passionate about helping others and meeting every caregiver with empathy, especially during some of the most tiring moments of parenthood. We are hiring for multiple part-time positions, 20 hours per week on set shifts, M-F 7am-11am PT or M-F 11am-3pm PT. These are hourly, part-time roles.
What You’ll Do
Provide expert, personalized sleep guidance

• Apply your knowledge of infant and child sleep development to give accurate, age-appropriate guidance aligned with Hatch ’s approved approaches and resources.

• Follow safe sleep guidelines and Hatch sleep training guidelines at all times.

• Ask purposeful questions to understand each family’s challenges, routines, goals, and circumstances, and adjust your recommendations as new information emerges.

• Help families put recommendations into practice, set realistic expectations, and troubleshoot obstacles.

• Guide caregivers to relevant Hatch Baby sleep features and content, and explain how they support their goals.

• Recognize when a concern is outside the scope of sleep support, including medical questions, feeding, and urgent situations, and refer families to their pediatrician or escalate through the appropriate channel

Communicate clearly and with empathy

• Write warm, concise responses suited to a chat conversation, leading with actionable next steps and explaining your reasoning.

• Respond to caregiver stress with validation, patience, and respect.

• Build confidence without judgment, pressure, or promises of specific sleep outcomes.

• Review all conversation history and context before responding.

• Document key details, recommendations, and next steps so another consultant can pick up the conversation seamlessly.

• Follow shared Hatch standards, and address differing recommendations thoughtfully to maintain trust.

• Manage your conversations efficiently while maintaining quality, and meet established response time and customer satisfaction expectations

Who You Are

•
Passionate about helping others. You care about caregivers and love helping a family feel confident and rested.

•
Empathetic. You build trust without judgment, even when a family is stressed or exhausted.

•
A strong writer. You communicate clearly, warmly, and concisely in writing.

•
Detail-oriented. You keep accurate documentation and notice the details that matter in each family’s story.

•
Experienced with sleep. You have experience with infant and child sleep develop

• Nosso time  atua no modelo híbrido , unindo a flexibilidade do trabalho remoto com a troca do presencial no nosso escritório 1 vez por semana.

Sobre a Área e o Desafio

 

O Manager de Segmentação traduz a carteira de Cobrança e Despejo em personas de clientes bem definidas - grupos caracterizados por diferentes perfis, motivações e comportamentos de pagamento - e estabelece, em nível macro, a estratégia de tratamento que cada persona exige.

A atuação dessa posição vai muito além da modelagem estatística. Esta pessoa é responsável por responder por que um determinado grupo deve ser tratado de forma diferente de outro, qual hipótese comportamental sustenta essa diferenciação e qual abordagem maximiza a recuperação financeira e a experiência do cliente para cada perfil. O principal entregável é uma tese estratégica defensável por persona , que servirá como pilar fundamental para a execução das frentes de Políticas, Jornada e Operações.

O papel combina raciocínio estruturado e profundidade analítica: diagnosticar padrões ao longo da carteira, formular hipóteses sobre seus motivadores e convertê-los em direcionamento estratégico de alto impacto diante da liderança sênior.

 

Suas Responsabilidades

 

1. Definir as personas de clientes da carteira

•
Construir e evoluir a segmentação que traduz o portfólio em personas , considerando perfil de risco, comportamento de pagamento, contexto da inadimplência, relacionamento com o produto e potencial de valor.

•
Caracterizar cada persona de forma acionável: o que define o grupo, como ele se comporta, o que motiva a resolução do débito e onde está sua principal barreira para pagamento.

•
Definir critérios de classificação e reclassificação que regem a migração dos clientes entre personas ao longo do ciclo de vida de cobrança.

2. Liderar a macroestratégia de tratamento por persona

•
Definir a abordagem ideal para cada persona : nível de esforço a investir, postura de engajamento, tipo de solução com maior potencial de conversão e prioridade relativa em relação aos demais perfis.

•
Deixar clara a racionalidade estratégica - quais características do grupo justificam aplicar o Tratamento A em vez do Tratamento B.

•
Identificar personas sub ou supreatendidas sob a lógica atual e recomendar a alocação correta de esforços.

•
Traduzir a estratégia de personas em direcionamentos claros para os times de Políticas, Jornadas, Produto e Operações.

3. Diagnósticos e insights comportamentais

•
Executar análises de coorte, curva de recuperação, propensão e migração para sustentar e refinar as teses de tratamento.

•
Trazer uma visão outside-in (benchmarking de outros mercados, indústrias e áreas correlatas) para desafiar a forma como carteiras dessa natureza são tradicionalmente agrupadas e tratadas.

Job Title:
Clinical Research Coordinator - Comprehensive Cancer Center Department:
CCC | Sponsored Research Position Summary
The Clinical Research Coordinator serves as a key member of a multidisciplinary research team supporting federally funded and foundation-funded research projects focused on cancer prevention, cancer control, health disparities, survivorship, and other health-related outcomes in rural and medically underserved communities throughout Ohio. This position is responsible for coordinating and implementing complex clinical and community-based research studies, with a particular emphasis on engaging participants in rural and Appalachian regions.

The Clinical Research Coordinator independently manages day-to-day research operations, facilitates participant recruitment and retention, maintains regulatory compliance, coordinates community partnerships, and ensures timely completion of study milestones. The position requires frequent interaction with study participants, healthcare providers, community organizations, and external collaborators across Ohio. Regular travel throughout rural Ohio is required.

Responsibilities

• Coordinates multiple clinical, population-based, and community-engaged research studies.

• Implements study protocols and standard operating procedures in accordance with sponsor, institutional, and regulatory requirements.

• Oversees participant recruitment, enrollment, informed consent, data collection, and follow-up activities.

• Schedules and conducts study visits in clinical, community, and virtual settings.

• Maintains study databases and participant tracking systems.

• Assists investigators with study startup, activation, and closeout activities.

• Monitors study progress and ensures adherence to project timelines and deliverables.

• Serves as a primary liaison between research teams and community partners across rural Ohio.

• Builds and maintains relationships with healthcare organizations, community health centers, faith-based organizations, local health departments, and other stakeholders.

• Coordinates outreach events, educational programs, health fairs, screening initiatives, and community meetings.

• Assists with development and implementation of culturally appropriate recruitment and retention strategies.

• Supports Community Advisory Boards and stakeholder engagement activities.

• Facilitates participant navigation and addresses barriers to study participation.

• Prepares and submits Institutional Review Board (IRB) applications, amendments, continuing reviews, and reportable events.

• Maintains regulatory binders and study documentation.

• Ensures compliance with federal regulations, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), HIPAA, and university policies.

• Participates in study monitoring visits, audits, and sponsor reviews.

• Tracks protocol deviations and assists with corrective action plans when necessary.

• Collects, enters, verifies, and manages research data using electronic data capture systems.

• Performs quality assurance and quality control

ABOUT SANDBOXAQ

SandboxAQ is a high-growth company delivering AI solutions that address some of the world's greatest challenges. The company’s Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) power advances in life sciences, financial services, navigation, cybersecurity, and other sectors.

We are a global team that is tech-focused and includes experts in AI, chemistry, cybersecurity, physics, mathematics, medicine, engineering, and other specialties. THE OPPORTUNITY

Introduction to the team: The Magnets team is one of several key research verticals within SandboxAQ’s broader Chemical Simulation group, which uses advanced computational methods, physics-based simulation, and AI to discover and develop novel materials. This group is focused on solving critical materials challenges that matter to U.S. semiconductor manufacturing and industrial resilience.

Within that larger effort, this group is focused on one of the most strategically important materials problems: developing high-performance permanent magnets that reduce or eliminate reliance on neodymium and other rare earth elements and can be produced in the United States. The goal is to create novel magnet formulations that can be manufactured using existing industry processes and equipment, while matching or exceeding the performance of today’s leading NdFeB magnets in demanding applications such as semiconductor equipment, vacuum systems, precision motion devices, and defense technologies.

This person will define the research strategy and technical roadmap, build and lead a top-tier scientific team, and help shape how computational materials discovery, simulation, and AI are applied to accelerate magnet development.

This leader will work at the intersection of domain science and platform innovation. You will help shape the magnetism-aware LQM and multi-scale modeling strategy in close partnership with our AI simulation platform teams, while also guiding dataset strategy, modeling priorities, and experimental validation to turn cutting-edge research into practical, manufacturable magnet technologies.

You will also serve as a key external scientific representative for the program, working with national labs, manufacturing partners, defense organizations, and equipment companies.

- Own the scientific charter and technical roadmap for the Magnets vertical, including phase stability, magnetocrystalline anisotropy, finite-temperature coercivity, and microstructure engineering across Fe- and Co-based intermetallic systems with U.S.-accessible alloying elements.

- IP Engine Management: Oversee the translation of generative design outputs into a robust IP portfolio, ensuring the team owns the most valuable "white space" in substrate chemistry and structural design.

- Build, lead, and mentor a multidisciplinary team of research scientists, computational/ML scientists, and postdocs; set the scientific bar, run technical reviews, and develop talent toward NewCo readiness.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will own the technical direction of Alpaca 's streaming platform - our Redpanda-based event backbone and the user-facing streaming infrastructure. We own client-facing and internal services, maintain shared libraries nearly every team depends on, and manage our own deployments. Most of our time goes into Go, but we also write Helm charts, dig through logs and metrics, and get pulled into a wide variety of problems.

• Set the standards for event-driven design - schema evolution, topic ownership, replay, idempotency - and own the shared libraries other teams build against, including the cost of versioning and deprecation

• Shape AuthN/AuthZ direction across Alpaca and lead the work where identity meets streaming: authorizing real-time subscriptions, token lifecycle on long-lived connections, multi-tenant isolation

• Help shape how Alpaca builds with AI - the schemas, contracts and event streams you own are the substrate our agentic development platform runs on

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers - and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
Partnerships Sales Director
About the team and the role:
The Partnerships Sales Director at Goldin will play a critical role in maximizing the commercial value of inventory and opportunities generated through Goldin’s rapidly expanding partnerships business across professional and collegiate sports, leagues, teams, athletes, agencies, entertainment, music, brands, and other strategic partners.
This role will have a particular emphasis on sports and will be responsible for developing and executing the sales strategy for premium inventory received through Goldin’s team, league, and athlete partnerships, including game-used and game-worn memorabilia, historic artifacts, experiences, collections, and other unique assets.
Reporting directly to the Head of Partnerships, this individual will serve as the primary sales lead for partnership-generated inventory and will work closely with Goldin’s sales, consignment, auction, cataloging, marketing, content, authentication, and customer-facing teams to maximize revenue and sell-through across every partnership.
The ideal candidate has deep knowledge of sports memorabilia and the collectibles marketplace, understands how to evaluate and price unique assets, has strong relationships with collectors and buyers, and knows how to create demand around premium inventory. This person should be equally comfortable evaluating the potential value of a game-used jersey, developing a sales strategy around a major collection, speaking directly with a high-value collector, and advising internal teams on how and when an asset should be brought to market.
This is a highly commercial role for someone who understands that acquiring great inventory is only the beginning - the ultimate objective is maximizing its value once it reaches Goldin.
What you will accomplish:
Own the sales strategy for partnership inventory:

• Lead the sales and monetization strategy for inventory generated through Goldin’s partnerships with professional and collegiate teams, leagues, athletes, agencies, entertainment properties, brands, and other strategic partners.

• Serve as the primary commercial owner for partnership-generated inventory from the time assets are identified through auction, sale, and post-sale analysis.

• Develop pricing, valuation, auction placement, timing, and buyer-targeting strategies designed to maximize revenue and sell-through.

• Evaluate game-used and game-worn memorabilia, historic artifacts, player collections, experiences, and other unique assets based on market demand, comparable sales, scarcity, provenance, player significance, historical context, and collector behavior.

• Establish appropriate auction estimates, reserves, opening bids, and other pricing recommendations in collaboration with relevant internal stakeholders.

• Identify the highest-value and most commercially significant inventory within each partnership and develop individualized sales strategies around those assets.

• Recommend the appropriate sales channel for each opportunity, including premium auction, weekly auction, private sale, live commerce, curated collection, or other Goldin sales channels.

Drive collector demand and revenue:

• Develop and maintain relationships with high-value collectors, buyers, dealers, and other participants

In this position, you will work at the intersection of predictive analytics, actuarial thinking, and pricing strategy. You will partner closely with teammates and business partners to build, enhance, and refine models that support general liability insurance pricing. You will also have the opportunity to work across a variety of projects, expand your technical toolkit, and deepen your understanding of how modeling drives real business outcomes.

title: People Operations Manager
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

WHY JOIN US

- Work on a civilisation-scale problem - Clean, baseload fusion energy is one of the few genuinely world-changing challenges, and every hire in Finance, People, or Legal directly accelerates the path to a working stellarator.

- Grow as fast as the company does - With headcount set to roughly 5x in a few years and major technical milestones ahead on the path to our demo machine and first power plant, your role grows under you; today's hire is tomorrow's function lead.

- Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer.

As a People Operations Specialist, you'll help build the operational foundation that enables our teams to thrive as we grow internationally. Your work will ensure our people processes are efficient, scalable, and employee-centric.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Coordinate day-to-day people operations so everything runs smoothly across regions.

- Manage the administration of key employee lifecycle processes (onboarding, offboarding, etc.) and keep improving how they work.

- Spot inefficiencies and suggest practical improvements that align with business priorities.

description:

QMO is responsible for the quality benchmark that every Hasbro project adheres to - covering requirements through closure - across AI, automation, manual, performance, security, and compatibility testing. You will advise the technical aspects of our Selenium-to-Playwright migration, the integration of Tosca's AI/agentic features, and test coverage across SAP, P2M, and Hasbro CLM(which is migrating to AWS). • Lead the migration of automation suites from Selenium to Playwright, including framework architecture and standard methodologies.

• Manage the daily automation and AI-related activities of our offshore vendor team, determining priorities and evaluating output quality - without formal people-management responsibility.

• Take ownership for test case management and regression/defect tracking methods in qTest, ensuring they grow alongside the team's automation-first approach.

• Collaborate with SAP and P2M functional teams to integrate automation coverage into their release cycles.

title: FPGA Firmware Engineer
description: About Singular Photonics: Singular Photonics is a fast-growing fabless semiconductor start-up, developing Single-Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) sensors that bring advanced computation directly into imaging. Our sensors enable innovations across LiDAR, fluorescence lifetime imaging (FLIM), spectroscopy and time-resolved optical measurements, powering next-generation solutions for customers worldwide. Based at Orchard Brae House in Edinburgh, we are a close-knit team at the forefront of the photonics revolution. About the Role: We are seeking an FPGA Firmware Engineer to join our multidisciplinary R&D team. This is an FPGA role: you will design, implement and verify the Verilog firmware that powers our SPAD sensors, captures photon timing data at high rates and streams it to the host. Our sensors generate data faster than most imaging systems ever see, so the interesting problems here are real ones: clock domain crossing, timing closure and getting data off the device without losing a photon. You will work alongside our hardware, ASIC and software engineers, from architecture through to system bring-up and customer deployment. You will report to the Lead Firmware Engineer. Key Responsibilities: Architecture: Define FPGA requirements and architecture for SPAD sensor readout, in discussion with the hardware, ASIC and software teams. RTL Design: Implement, verify and debug Verilog modules for data acquisition, photon timing, histogramming and sensor control. Verification: Design and run simulations and testbenches, with coverage sufficient to trust the design before it reaches hardware. Synthesis & Timing: Own synthesis, constraints, clock domain crossing and timing closure on AMD-Xilinx FPGA family devices in Vivado. title: Database and Application Support Engineer (Senior)
description:
Overview
DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Database and Application Support Engineer to support database availability, application operations, service restoration, component upgrades, and recovery validation for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
The Database and Application Support Engineer will diagnose database outages, application dependencies, connection failures, unavailable services, certificate problems, and API-related issues. This role will support troubleshooting and restoration across database, application, middleware, server, network, cloud, and security components.
The engineer will coordinate operational response with Task 4 enterprise IT teams and work with Task 7 software-development teams when resolution requires application-code analysis or correction. The role will focus on production support, infrastructure integration, recovery, and technical coordination rather than serving as the primary application developer.
This position is remote, with a preference for candidates located in the Chicago area. After-hours work may be required during outages, deployments, maintenance windows, upgrades, and recovery activities.
Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.
Duties & Responsibilities
The Database and Application Support Engineer will:

• Monitor and support the availability, performance, health, and recoverability of enterprise databases and applications.

• Diagnose database availability issues, failed services, connection failures, authentication problems, resource constraints, and performance degradation.

• Analyze application dependencies across databases, servers, services, middleware, APIs, certificates, networks, cloud platforms, storage, and external interfaces.

• Troubleshoot database listeners, connection strings, connection pools, ports, drivers, service accounts, permissions, and network paths.

• Investigate failed database connections, application timeouts, unavailable services, transaction errors, and data-access issues.

• Review database, application, middleware, operating-system, web-server, API, and network logs to isolate faults.

• Use monitoring data, metrics, traces, alerts, logs, and event records to identify the source and scope of service disruptions.

• Diagnose certificate expiration, trust-chain, hostname, binding, private-key, protocol, and encryption-related failures.

• Support installation, renewal, replacement, validation, and troubleshooting of certificates used by applications, databases, APIs, and supporting services.

• Diagnose REST, SOAP, API gateway, endpoint, authentication, authorization, payload, timeout, and connectivity failures.

• Validate dependencies among APIs, backend services, databases, certificates, identity providers, and network controls.

• Support administration and troubleshooting of relational database platforms used within the enterprise environment.

• Support application servers, web servers, middleware, schedulers, integration services, background services, and supporting runtime components.

• Participate in Outage Response Team activities involving database or application degradation and service outages.

• Provide technical diagnosis, mitigation options, workarounds, recovery actions, restoration support, and service validation.

• Maintain detailed incident timelines covering symptoms, technical findings, actions, decisions, dependencies, communications, and restoration results.

• Escalate complex issues to database administrators, application owners, senior engineers, vendors, cloud providers, or development teams.

• Coordinate with Task 4 enterprise operations teams on infrastructure, server, network, cloud, storage, certificate, identity, and platform issues.

• Coordinate with Task 7 software-development teams when incidents require application-code review, defect correction, build changes, or software releases.

• Provide logs, traces, error

About Slash

Slash is a hi-tech startup studio with a mission to build tech AI-powered products and scalable digital platforms that create real-world impact. Since 2016, we’ve partnered with ambitious enterprises and government organizations to design, engineer, and launch cutting-edge solutions - with Generative AI at the core of what we do.

Headquartered in Singapore, our global team and clients operate R&D hubs across Southeast Asia. We are a team of entrepreneurs, engineers, and product builders dedicated to solving complex technical challenges and turning bold ideas into impactful technology.
About our Client

Our client’s product is an AI voice-sensing device, a breakthrough wearable that detects the gap between what someone says and how their voice actually sounds. Rooted in Pythagorean acoustic physics and the Navarasa framework, the system functions as a state detector rather than a conventional emotion labeler. The team is a small, fast-moving team building at the intersection of emotion labeling, ancient wisdom, and measurable science.
About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Machine Learning Engineer to take complete ownership of our full AI stack. Your primary responsibility will be expanding our speech emotion recognition (SER) model into a physics-based harmonic vocal state engine, alongside building and maintaining our dual-instance production LLM infrastructure. In this role, you will work directly with the Founder and Lead Developer with zero bureaucracy or committee oversight. We need an engineer who excels at owning problems end-to-end.
Key Responsibilities

1. Harmonic Vocal State Engine (Audio & Physics)

• Extend our inherited 30-class speech emotion recognition (SER) model, dataset, checkpoints, and pipeline into a physics-based harmonic detection system using Fourier-derived acoustic analysis and the Navarasa framework.

2. LLM Infrastructure & Operations

• Own prompt engineering, output validation, Pydantic schema enforcement, retry logic, and quality monitoring across 42 production prompts.

• Handle infrastructure scaling and migrations independently without reliance on third-party vendors.

3. Model Quality & Continuous Improvement

• Build evaluation pipelines to detect and catch regressions before users experience them.

• Continuously optimize and refine model performance as real-world audio accumulates from our device.

Requirements

Requirements & Qualifications

• Audio Signal Processing:Strong proficiency in the frequency domain (FFT, Fourier analysis, spectral features) and practical experience with audio processing libraries like librosa or torchaudio.

• Audio ML Frameworks:Hands-on experience with modern audio ML models (wav2vec2, HuBERT, WavLM) and a deep understanding of training, evaluating, and fine-tuning SER models.

Core Tech Stack:

• PyTorch & Python:Direct experience handling model checkpoints and training loops; ability to write clean, modular, maintainable production-level code.

Infrastructure & MLOps:

• GCP & vLLM:Experience managing cloud infrastructure and direct experience deploying and serving models via vLLM.

• Methodology & Communication:Proven ability to design rigorous evaluation frameworks and strong written English skills for an async-first team.

Nice to Have

• Experience designing or building physics-based audio analysis systems.

• Familiarity with the Navarasa framework, acoustic physics, or c

title: Cloud - Bare Metal Infrastructure Engineer
description:
At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI-native, full-stack, multi-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer-friendly platforms-so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure.

Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users.

Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive-designed for the speed of modern AI development.

We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you.

APPLYING TO RENDER

We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team.

We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed.

Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Most infrastructure engineers never get to build a cloud from the metal up. At Render, you will. Developers and businesses around the world run their apps on Render, and we are building our own bare metal footprint to give them better performance and economics. You'll help take our first colocation site from an empty cage to production workloads, then scale that foundation as we expand our physical presence to thousands of hosts over the coming years.

You'll join a small, experienced team with real ownership. You'll partner closely with network engineering and our Kubernetes platform team, and the decisions you make now will become the template for every site that follows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Take our first colocation site from empty cage to production workloads, then scale what you build as we grow to more sites and thousands of hosts

- Design how servers go from the loading dock to production with minimal human touch: netboot, imaging, BMC-driven discovery, and host identity

- Partner with network engineering on what the fleet needs from the network, from out-of-band management to production connectivity

- Build the interface our Kubernetes platform team uses to request capacity, see host health, and coordinate maintenance, so consuming bare metal feels as easy as consuming cloud

- Own the fleet's source of truth for hardware, software, and the physical environment

- Automate the full server lifecycle, from burn-in and acceptance testing through remediation, staged firmware rollout, and RMA

- Build automation like a production system, with guardrails on destructive actions and designs that survive site-level failure

- Shape the technical and operational direction of our bare metal platform, from build-vs-buy decisions to how we operate

description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers: Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search, all deeply integrated.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Developers decide what to build with by listening to people they trust, much of it on Twitter, where Supabase's community, launches, and competitors are all discussed in public. We want a senior DevRel leader who is already a known, trusted voice there, to be a brand ambassador for Supabase. You'll work alongside our New Media and DevRel teams and help shape how Supabase shows up in these conversations. We hire for the voice and following you already have.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Be a visible, trusted voice for Supabase on Twitter: post, reply, and join developer conversations daily.

- Share sharp, useful content, from launches and tips to opinions on where building is going.

- Represent Supabase at events, on podcasts, and in the wider developer community.

- Bring developer feedback to engineering and product, and work with New Media, DevRel, and PMM on launches.

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF

- You have an existing, engaged Twitter following. We'll look at who you talk to and how people respond, as well as follower count.

- You have senior experience in DevRel, developer advocacy, or a similar developer-facing role.

- You're credible with a technical audience and a strong writer with a distinctive voice.

- You're comfortable representing a company publicly, on camera, on stage, and online.

- High agency and self-directed.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Fully Remote

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- ESOP

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- Tech Allowance

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment-laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- Health Benefits

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- Annual Off-Sites

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- Flexible Work

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- Professional Development

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning-courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support-not replace-existing tools and communities.

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

THE ROLE

As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the local and cloud sandboxed environments that make interactive and autonomous agentic workflows trustworthy by default. At the heart of our trust model is the fact that user credentials and other sensitive secrets are injected at the sandbox layer and never exposed to an agent. An agent can never leak secrets it never sees. The Secrets team builds the software that makes that possible, from easy-to-use SDKs to secure cloud services. We operate at the intersection of the developer experience, enterprise governance, and security-delivering core security features that make Docker sandboxes the best way to run agents and other workloads safely. In this role, you would manage this team, owning its technical direction and delivery and being accountable for its operational excellence.

The successful candidate is a hands-on engineer at heart. They have built secure software and scale-out cloud services, and they use that experience to guide their team to sound architectural decisions and a high security bar. They think naturally about isolation and trust boundaries and understand the tradeoffs of running untrusted or semi-trusted workloads. They are skilled at growing and retaining senior individual contributors and thrive in a remote-first environment. They stay close to customers, because the gap between a strong security model and something people actually adopt is where the real work happens.

- Lead a team of engineers building Docker's shared Secrets platform and own its technical direction.

micro1 is looking for experienced Pediatric Hematology/Oncology Physicians to support a customer project focused on improving AI-generated clinical documentation.

What you'll do

• Review AI-generated transcripts of outpatient pediatric hematology/oncology visits for clinical accuracy, completeness, and clarity.

• Evaluate clinical documentation, including History of Present Illness (HPI), interval histories, and Assessment and Plans (A&Ps).

• Identify inaccuracies or missing details related to chemotherapy regimens, treatment toxicities, supportive care, and laboratory findings.

• Review how documentation captures caregiver involvement, shared decision-making, and psychosocial considerations.

• Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve AI-generated clinical notes and EHR documentation.

• MD, DO, or equivalent medical degree, with board certification or eligibility in Pediatric Hematology/Oncology.

• At least 2 years of recent outpatient pediatric hematology/oncology experience following fellowship.

• Strong experience managing chemotherapy, longitudinal patient care, and treatment-related complications.

• Proven ability to independently document HPIs, interval histories, and Assessment and Plans.

• Solid understanding of pediatric chemotherapy protocols, transfusion practices, supportive care, and age-specific laboratory interpretation.

• Strong written communication skills and attention to clinical detail.

• Based in the United States.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience treating both malignant and non-malignant pediatric hematologic conditions, such as sickle cell disease, hemophilia, and ITP.

• Familiarity with AI scribe technology, EHR documentation templates, medical chart review, or clinical annotation projects.

Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.

Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2 https://www.g2.com/products/tremendous/reviews.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We're a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees- our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

About the role

We’re looking for a Head of Demand Generation to lead our next phase of growth by building qualified sales pipeline and acquiring self-serve customers.

You’ll lead a strong team of paid media marketing professionals, setting the strategy for where to invest, what to test, and how to scale. You’ll bring media and creative execution together to produce winning ads that attract and convert the right customers, with a clear mandate to embed AI into how the team works - from execution and analysis to autonomous optimization.

Reporting to the VP of Marketing, you’ll turn our ambitious growth targets into a focused strategy and measurable results.

What you'll do

- Set the growth strategy. Turn business targets into clear channel priorities, budgets, and experiments. Decide where to double down and where to pull back.

- Lead and develop the team. Give people clear direction, strengthen their judgment, and help them grow.

- Make creative a growth lever. Partner with Product Marketing and Content to turn our value propositions into ads that connect with buyers. Build a steady rhythm of testing and learning.

- Turn data into decisions. Connect spend to customer quality, pipeline, and business results. Make clear calls even when the data is messy.

- Improve the full funnel. Grow lifecycle marketing motions, partner with RevOps & Sales on segment prioritization and align with product to improve conversion and product-led growth.

- Lead the team’s AI transformation. Build agentic workflows that move from supporting execution to analyzing performance and, over time, independently optimizing campaigns.

What you'll bring

- 10+ years in marketing, with a proven record of leading demand generation and hitting growth targets.

- Experience scaling paid media based on data driven insights.

- Strong people leadership. You develop talent, set clear expectations, and help them reach their full potential.

- Analytical judgment. You can turn incomplete, messy data into clear priorities and useful learnings.

- Creative instincts. You know how to bring a value proposition to life and assess whether creative connects with its audience.

- Practical experience with AI and agentic workflows, and the curiosity to keep pushing what they can do.

- Strategic range and attention to detail. You connect the bigger picture, work well across functions, and dig into the specifics when needed.

- Clear written communication and comfort working in a documentation-first, low-meeting culture.

What's cool about the role

- Fast growth. You'll work at a company growing quickly yet sustainably. We’re profitable with plenty more opportunity ahead.

- Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: $250,000 - $300,000.

- Real benefits. 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave.

- Fully remote.

- Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook https://handbook.tremendous.com/.

As a Launcher for Asia, you will carry out Quartermaster's market entry across one of the world's busiest and most strategically important maritime regions. - Partner Onboarding: Move signed partners to installation, coordinating with Field Operations so vessels are ready and deployments run without delay.

- Relationship Management: Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for fleets, ports, and vendors in assigned markets, keeping partners engaged after installation.

Reporting & Coordination

- Market Intelligence: Gather local insight on regional dynamics, technical requirements, and localized risks to inform regional strategy.

What you need

- Experience: 5+ years in operations, market entry, business development, or government relations roles, ideally within maritime, logistics, defense, or other highly regulated sectors.

- Regional Expertise: Working knowledge of the political, regulatory, and commercial landscape across Asia's ports and maritime economies.

title: MADRS Clinical Rater (Dutch Fluency)
description:
About Cogstate

At Cogstate , we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.
Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate ’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.
Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.
At Cogstate , we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.
About the Clinician Network
By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.
Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter , which shares updates and upcoming openings.
About the Role
Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.
Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.
*These are contract position.
*They are fully remote.
*Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

- MADRS Administration Experience Required
- Dutch Fluency Required

Key Responsibilities
Central Rating

• Remotely administering semi-structured clinical interview assessments and cognitive battery of tests to study subjects and caregivers.

• Remotely delivering computerized and traditional cognitive assessments via a tele-health platform.

• Scoring completed scale administrations.

• Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

• Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.

• Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

Qualifications & Expertise

• MD, DO, MBBS or PhD, PsyD in Psychology or RN, APRN, PA, MA/MS/MSW in Psychiatry (or equivalent)

• Formal training in clinical interviewing and cognitive assessment

• Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience with direct clinical interviewing and psychological assessment in clinical research industry, academic or clinical settings

• Direct experience with cognitive/behavioral/functional assessment of neurological/psychiatric populations

• Ability to meet deadlines, being highly organized and methodical, with attention to detail to ensure delivery

• Proficiency with MS Office, including Word and Exce
